title: FM27 Mods — Real Name Fix, Facepacks & Compatibility
description: FM27 mods checked 30 October 2026: Real Name Fix V2, facepack and logo compatibility, 2D versus 3D kits, and installation checks for the Launch Preview.
meta: Updated 30 October 2026 · Launch Preview · Author-reported compatibility; downloads not tested by this site.
body:
FM27 mods are already appearing during the Launch Preview. The first practical options are a real names fix and existing graphics packs whose maintainers explicitly support FM27. Check the pack’s own instructions: graphics, database fixes and interface replacements install in different places.

What is available now

TypeSource checked 30 October 2026Compatibility stated by the maintainer
Real names fixsortitoutsi FM27 Real Name Fix V2, updated 30 OctoberFM27; author says the included naming and German national-team fixes are save-game compatible.
Cut-out faces and logossortitoutsi graphics downloadsThe site’s FM27 notice says these work even when the pack version still reads 2026.XX.
2D kitsSame FM27 compatibility noticeReported compatible by sortitoutsi. Match the pack’s scope and installation guide to your game.
3D kitsSame FM27 compatibility noticeNot confirmed by the source. Do not treat 2D compatibility as proof for 3D kits.
Skins and interface changesFM27 skins and installation notesFM27 releases now exist; some replace game asset bundles rather than using a traditional skins folder.

This is a source check, not a test of downloaded files in our own game. Follow the linked maintainer pages for the current file, platform support and later corrections. We do not rehost the downloads.

FM27 Real Name Fix: where it goes

The sortitoutsi fix changes unlicensed award, city, stadium and competition names and addresses Germany’s national-team selection. Its author describes these fixes as save-game compatible. That statement applies to this named fix, not every editor file or database mod.

  1. Close FM27 and make a backup of the files you will replace.
  2. Open your actual FM27 installation. On Windows Steam, the author’s path ends in Football Manager 27/shared/data/database/db. On macOS Steam it ends in Football Manager 27/fm.app/Contents/PlugIns/game_plugin.bundle/Contents/Resources/shared/data/database/db. Custom library locations can change the earlier part of the path.
  3. Read the current author instructions. V2 lists the dbc, edt and lnc folders and says to copy them into each database folder it identifies, rather than only 2700.
  4. Use the current package’s replacement method. The author’s 29 October clarification says blank files are included to overwrite the older fake-name files. Do not combine that method with a deletion checklist from an older FM edition.
  5. Check a known affected name in-game. After a game update, return to the author’s page in case the database directories or fix have changed.

These paths belong to the installation directory. A facepack or logo guide may instead use a user-data directory; placing every kind of mod in one generic folder is not a valid install method.

FM27 logo packs and licensed assets

For pack selection and missing-badge checks, see the FM27 logo-pack guide.

Check what the game already includes first: Sports Interactive confirms official club logos, kits and player photos for the licensed Arkema Première Ligue. A missing badge in Preview is not by itself proof that a graphics pack is broken; some club and player assets still await rights-holder approval.

FM27 facepacks, logos and kits: check one change at a time

Use the selected pack’s installation instructions, preserve its folder structure and configuration files, and check a club or player the pack actually covers. If the graphics do not appear, use the pack author’s FM27-specific cache or refresh guidance. Do not assume an older edition’s menu or folder layout is unchanged.

Existing artwork can be reused while other parts of a pack still need attention. In particular, sortitoutsi’s compatibility notice supports cut-out faces, logos and 2D kits but explicitly leaves 3D kits unconfirmed.

Before adding editor data or a tool

  • Match the file to FM27 and the game build it supports; an FM26 label is not interchangeable.
  • Check whether a new save is required. The real names fix’s save compatibility is not a rule for unrelated custom databases.
  • Record any transfer update used with a save before comparing player fees or wonderkid profiles.
  • Back up saves and original game files, then install one change before checking the next.
